matched.title: Object.assign(input) overwrites generated fetch and bypasses middleware
matched.failure: defineHandler({ fetch: f, middleware: [auth] }).fetch("/x") calls f directly with a string. Auth middleware is skipped, and f receives a string instead of a Request.
notes: severity lowered from warn to inform: a second reading did not confirm the failing case (Copying `input.fetch` over the generated fetch is what 'universal `{ fetch }` handlers' sets out to do. The updated test asserts `eventHandler.fetch` is the raw fetch handler, and the route path (`handler = event => input.fetch(event.req)`) still runs middleware.)
